name: Brimstone Bus
source:
A submission for O2A2 2023. A simple project where a demon bus driver heads to Veiga, monologuing  in the mental prison he has created for himself.

[From [url=https://elijahwoodcake.itch.io/brimstone-bus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
O2A2 2023的提交作品。一个简单的项目，一名恶魔巴士司机前往维加，在他为自己创建的精神监狱中独白。

[来自[url=https://elijahwoodcake.itch.io/brimstone-bus]itch.io[/url]]
